S_G_P_SHIN_GETTER_ONE.title: Shin Getter 1
S_G_P_SHIN_GETTER_ONE.description: Shin Getter 1 form. When you transform into this form, gain 1 Vigor.
S_G_P_SHIN_GETTER_TWO.title: Shin Getter 2
S_G_P_SHIN_GETTER_TWO.description: Shin Getter 2 form. When you transform into this form, gain 1 Regen; max Energy +1, draw 1 additional card, and Block gained from cards is halved.
S_G_P_SHIN_GETTER_THREE.title: Shin Getter 3
S_G_P_SHIN_GETTER_THREE.description: Shin Getter 3 form. When you transform into this form, gain 1 Plating; lose 2 Strength and 2 Dexterity; whenever you gain Block, gain 1 Plating.
S_G_P_SHIN_FORM.title: Shin Form
S_G_P_SHIN_FORM.description: Shin Getter Dragon form. Max Energy +1, draw 1 additional card, Strength and Dexterity -2; whenever you gain Block, gain 1 Plating, and count as Shin Getter 1, Shin Getter 2, and Shin Getter 3.
S_G_P_FIGHTING_SPIRIT.title: Fighting Spirit
S_G_P_FIGHTING_SPIRIT.description: Before being attacked, deal {Amount} damage to the attacker.
S_G_P_KI.title: Ki
S_G_P_KI.description: At the start of your turn, gain Vigor equal to this amount. Final damage taken is reduced by this amount. Whenever you take damage, lose 1 stack.
S_G_P_SUPER_KI.title: Super Spirit
S_G_P_SUPER_KI.description: At the start of each turn, add 1 Spirit to your hand.
S_G_P_EVOLUTION.title: Evolution
S_G_P_EVOLUTION.description: At the start of your turn, after Ki resolves, convert up to this amount of Vigor, Regen, and Plating into Strength, Max HP, and Dexterity respectively. If at least one resource is converted, lose 1 Evolution.
S_G_P_EVOLUTION_ENGINE.title: Evolution Engine
S_G_P_EVOLUTION_ENGINE.description: The turn after Evolution triggers, gain {Amount:energyIcons()}.
S_G_P_AIRBORNE.title: Airborne
S_G_P_AIRBORNE.description: Damage taken is halved. At the end of your turn, reduce by 1. When this status is lost, gain 1 Vulnerable.
S_G_P_RADIATION.title: Radiation
S_G_P_RADIATION.description: Each stack increases damage taken by 25%. Current increase: {DamageIncreasePercent}%.
S_G_P_WANE.title: Wane
S_G_P_WANE.description: Take additional damage equal to this amount. Whenever you take unblocked damage, normally increase by 1. At the start of your turn, halve this amount.
S_G_P_SEAL.title: Seal
S_G_P_SEAL.description: Status amounts cannot increase or decrease this turn.
S_G_P_SHADE.title: Shade
S_G_P_SHADE.description: This turn, multi-hit attacks can only damage you once, and non-multi-hit attack damage is halved.
S_G_P_TRIPLE_UNITY.title: Triple Unity
S_G_P_TRIPLE_UNITY.description: After you play the next {Amount} cards, Transform.
S_G_P_INDOMITABLE.title: Persist
S_G_P_INDOMITABLE.description: Convert the next {Amount} instances of HP loss into [gold]Delayed Damage[/gold].
S_G_P_DELAY_DAMAGE.title: Delayed Damage
S_G_P_DELAY_DAMAGE.description: Take {Amount} damage at the end of next turn. This damage ignores Block and is affected by damage modifiers when it resolves.
S_G_P_ACCELERATION.title: Accel
S_G_P_ACCELERATION.description: Gain {Amount:energyIcons()} and draw {Amount} additional card(s) each turn.
S_G_P_CHOSEN_ONE.title: Chosen One
S_G_P_CHOSEN_ONE.description: Whenever you Transform, gain {Amount} Ki and {Block} Block.
S_G_P_WARRIOR_MEDAL.title: Warrior Medal
S_G_P_WARRIOR_MEDAL.description: At the start of your turn, gain {Amount} Regen and Plating.
S_G_P_GRAPPLE.title: Grapple
S_G_P_GRAPPLE.description: Multi-hit attacks played this turn hit {Amount} fewer time(s).
S_G_P_HOT_BLOOD.title: Valor
S_G_P_HOT_BLOOD.description: The next Attack card you play deals double damage.
S_G_P_GETTER_RAY_OVERFLOW.title: Getter Ray Burst
S_G_P_GETTER_RAY_OVERFLOW.description: Cards with Getter in their name cost {Amount} less. Whenever you play one, gain {Amount} [getter_ray]Evolution[/getter_ray].
S_G_P_DESPERATION.title: Desperation
S_G_P_DESPERATION.description: At the end of combat, heal {Amount} HP.
S_G_P_BLUEPRINT.title: Blueprint
S_G_P_BLUEPRINT.description: Whenever you lose HP, gain {Amount} Evolution.
S_G_P_AWAKENED_SOUL.title: Awakened Soul
S_G_P_AWAKENED_SOUL.description: At the start of your turn, gain {Amount} Vigor.
S_G_P_INSIGHT.title: Foresight
S_G_P_INSIGHT.description: At the start of your turn, if an enemy intends to attack, gain {Amount} Dexterity this turn.
S_G_P_INFINITE_EVOLUTION.title: Infinite Evolution
S_G_P_INFINITE_EVOLUTION.description: After winning combat, randomly gain {Amount} permanent Strength, Dexterity, or Max HP.
S_G_P_OVERLOAD.title: Overload
S_G_P_OVERLOAD.description: At the start of next turn, lose {Amount:energyIcons()}.
S_G_P_CHAIN_REACTION.title: Chain Reaction
S_G_P_CHAIN_REACTION.description: Whenever you lose Vigor, gain {Amount} Regen and Plating.
S_G_P_IRON_WALL.title: Wall
S_G_P_IRON_WALL.description: Until the start of next turn, all damage taken is reduced by {Amount}.
S_G_P_TOMAHAWK.title: Tomahawk
S_G_P_TOMAHAWK.description: At the start of your turn, play Getter Tomahawk {Amount} additional time(s).
S_G_P_DARK_CAPE.title: Black Cape
S_G_P_DARK_CAPE.description: This turn, whenever Block fully blocks damage, deal {Amount} damage to ALL enemies.
S_G_P_ENABLE.title: Enable
S_G_P_ENABLE.description: After the current turn ends, gain {Amount} extra turn(s).
S_G_P_FINAL_GETTER_BEAM.title: Final Getter Beam
S_G_P_FINAL_GETTER_BEAM.description: Whenever [gold]Wane[/gold] takes unblocked damage, it increases by {Amount} instead of 1.
S_G_P_KUSUHA_JUICE.title: Kusuha Juice
S_G_P_KUSUHA_JUICE.description: This turn, Spirit Command cards ignore Ki requirements and cost 0.
